description: List ruler guides, move them, lock or unlock them, make them liquid or ruler guides, or delete them, including every guide on a spread (select guides and drag, Lock Guide, View > Grids & Guides > Delete All Guides on Spread). Positions are mm from the top or left of the guide's page.

action.description: What to do with the guides

by.description: move: distance to move (mm; down or right is positive)

locked.description: set: lock or unlock the guides

spreadIndex.description: All guides on this spread (0-based); delete with only spreadIndex is Delete All Guides on Spread

to.description: move: the new position, mm from the top (horizontal guide) or left (vertical guide) of its page

type.description: set: liquid guides tell the guide-based liquid rule what may stretch; ruler guides are plain guides

name: manage_guides
title: Manage Guides
